_why: Crops applied to content/refs-images after extraction. The pipeline cut a generous box around each detected FIG/TABLE caption; almost every one came out clean, but a few carry page prose that has nothing to do with the figure. content/ is gitignored — the images are licensed — so the correction has to live here as data, or it is lost the next time the images are regenerated. Boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] in the ORIGINAL image's pixels. Run: python3 tools/trim-figure.py --apply-crops content/refs-images

ischemia/045_FIG.33.22_p047.jpg.why: Page 47 came through as a full two-column page: six lines of the preceding paragraph and a section heading above the artwork, and the page's right-hand column of prose running down beside it. Reported from an iPad, where the figure — a wavefront-of-necrosis diagram whose four panels are the whole point — was a strip in the middle of a wall of text. The box keeps the Reversible/Irreversible labels, all four panels, the timeline, the Results boxes and the complete FIG 33.22 legend.
